reviews.text: The staff are very knowledgeable with the food options and have great tips for pets. Good selection, and the cutest / sweetest resident cat
Very friendly service. Nice local business with high quality pet products.
I love this store. The staff are always so friendly and accommodating. They have amazing and helpful knowledge on pet supplies.

I absolutely love this store.

They staff are friendly, the bodega cat is adorable, the quality is unmatched, and the prices are reasonable.

I will always stop by even if it's just to grab a new flavour of tube-treat for my cat to try before I buy a whole bag. Their $5 surprise bags are always a hoot!
Incredible store! So many products and very knowledgeable and welcoming staff. I got some great advice and sugvestions there, plus you can meet a super chill cat Rupert!

Been coming here every other week since I got my cat in October last year. These guys are awesome, great selection of products and very helpful! If there is something you want but don't see they are willing to check with their suppliers and order it in for you! Rupert and Remi are the on site feline canine mascot duo and they always ensure a great experience, the human staff are amazing as well. I love that they take donations for pet toys and supplies for those in need. They are simply the best pet store around!

Very friendly, no-pressure store! Got some really good tips from a store associate about our family’s first kitten! Pricing seems decent and affordable too. Definitely recommend and will come back (for more tips) in the future! (^__^)

Is not what it was in the past. More concerned about standards of the staff than the needs of the customers.

Further to respond to the owners scenario of what transpired (she wasn't there) is a fiction. I never got much through the door when the cashier shrieked at me  'WE'RE CLOSED'. The debit issue is a 'Red Herring'.
Certain members of long term staff have come to feel the customer is more of an imposition on their lives.

We just walked in to buy some dog shampoo, and the second i leaned over the cat immediately jumped on my shoulders like a parrot, the owner was absolutely fantastic and extremely helpful. It was a wonderful experience and I’ll definitely be coming back!

I love this place! The lovely lady that works here helped me find a cat litter that doesn't harm my kitty with toxic fragrances like the brands you might find in the grocery store.

WARNING: If you use a scented litter for your cat's box that is from the grocery store, it is most likely toxic to you cat. Does your cat cough? Often? Does it seem to be getting worse over time? There is a big clue for anyone willing to take a long hard look & consider the reality.

On a good note: The litter that was recommended to me is made from compressed grass and corn. It absorbs the smell better than any cat litter I've ever used. My cat likes it and he has stopped coughing.  However, I had implemented a little herbal detox for the little guy as well. When I feed him wet food I always mix a little pinch of activated charcoal into it (I take this as well, but a bit more than my little feline friend) & then I mix in a table spoon or 2 of a tea that I make weekly & keep in the fridge for my cat. It depends on what I have growing in my gardens or what I have dried or rarely, what I have bought as I prefer to grow herbs myself, but the tea will have any combination of the following herbs: Rosemary, Catnip, Sage, Mullein, Cilantro. Those are all excellent in supporting the body (human or feline) in removal of toxins from the body.

So, again, thank you so much!
Peace, Love, & Light,
Mic.
